name: Moose
notes: Adult moose broadside. The heart–lung area is larger than 30 cm; the zone is kept smaller for a margin. Energy is a common guideline at the animal, not a law. Sweden: class 1 rifle ammunition.

name: Red deer
notes: Stag or hind broadside. Energy is a common guideline at the animal, not a law. Sweden: class 1 rifle ammunition.

name: Elk (wapiti)
notes: North American elk broadside. 2000 J is the often quoted 1500 ft·lbf at the animal; a guideline, not a law.

name: Fallow deer
notes: Buck or doe broadside. Energy is a common guideline at the animal, not a law. Sweden: class 1 rifle ammunition.

name: White-tailed deer
notes: Broadside. 20 cm is the familiar 8-inch vital zone; 1350 J is the often quoted 1000 ft·lbf. Guidelines, not law.

name: Roe deer
notes: Buck or doe broadside. Energy is a guideline at the animal, not a law. Sweden: class 2 rifle ammunition or stricter; shotgun allowed too.

name: Wild boar
notes: Adult boar broadside; the vitals sit low and well forward, behind the front leg. Energy is a guideline, not a law. Sweden: class 1 rifle ammunition.

name: Mouflon
notes: Male broadside. Sizes and the zone are estimates. Sweden: class 1 rifle ammunition.

name: Brown bear
notes: Adult bear broadside. Energy is a guideline at the animal, not a law. Sweden: class 1 rifle ammunition.

name: Red fox
notes: Broadside. A rough guideline for small game; follow your bullet maker's expansion data. Sweden: class 3 rifle ammunition or stricter; shotgun allowed too; class 4 at the den or under ground.

name: Badger
notes: Broadside; height to the back. Sizes and the zone are estimates. Sweden: class 3 rifle ammunition or stricter; shotgun allowed too; class 4 at the den or under ground.

name: ISSF 300 m rifle target
notes: 10 ring 100 mm, 1 ring 1000 mm. The hit zone is the 600 mm black (rings 5–10).

name: ISSF 50 m rifle target
notes: 10 ring 10.4 mm, 1 ring 154.4 mm. The hit zone is the 112.4 mm black (rings 4–10).

name: ISSF 10 m air rifle target
notes: 10 ring 0.5 mm (a dot), 1 ring 45.5 mm. The hit zone is the 30.5 mm black (rings 4–9).
